title: On Central, the launcher's node tests run against the installed engram.exe and fail 13 source-identity cases, so a registered FULL cannot pass
outcome: On Central, the launcher's node tests run against the installed engram.exe and fail 13 source-identity cases, so a registered FULL cannot pass
acceptance: The cause is confirmed by a discriminating check: the first failing test run alone on a clean master checkout on Central, plus the code path by which these tests select their owner.

The 13 launcher tests pass on Central with the installed engram.exe present, without uninstalling or changing it, because they use the fixture owner they create themselves; they still pass on DL560 and Windows B.
A registered Central full gate (full --input commit) passes its node-helper-tests stage.

completion.summary: Landed the seven-file launcher fixture repair on origin/master at exact 3089bfaf, with no installed executable change. Nested Node launcher tests select the fixture owner and exercise the current compact source envelope. Central and Windows B 566/0/1, DL560 547/0/16 with all 13 affected cases passing. Registered Central full test-69ddade9 passed all six stages, including node-helper-tests 566/0/1, with clean identical request/before/after source_ids. Independent review adopted on byte-identical contribution, zero Medium+ with two optional Lows. Independent pre- and post-landing evaluations passed 3/3; latest evaluation e4dc07391440413d89425818bd7bde53 is fresh at this source. Both exact author refs removed and confirmed absent; Windows B runner released for cleanup. Archived the original gate JSON artifacts for the independently tracked bound-verification issue, whose admission outcome is separate from this item's unbound judgment criteria.
